gates.reason: CLAUDE_HUB_REMOTE may contain embedded credentials and is persisted verbatim in the cached clone's origin URL.
This publisher does not implement recommendation detectors, evidence claims, calculations, historical-signal presentation, or validated fix snippets.

Inspected sync traversal, repeated origin lookup, transcript scrubbing, retry behavior, and cache retention; origin memoization, scrub staging/cache reuse, and bounded pruning prevent a verified release-gate hotspot.

findings.title: Credential-bearing CLAUDE_HUB_REMOTE is persisted in the cached Git configuration
findings.where: tools/cloud-capture/publish-claude.sh:814-820 accepts CLAUDE_HUB_REMOTE verbatim, while tools/cloud-capture/publish-claude.sh:354-356 writes REMOTE into origin.url.
findings.what: When CLAUDE_HUB_REMOTE is an HTTPS URL containing userinfo, such as https://token@example/repo.git, the secret is cloned with and then explicitly persisted in $HUB_DIR/.git/config. This contradicts the script's tokenless-remote policy and leaves a reusable credential at rest in the transcript cache.
findings.fix: Reject CLAUDE_HUB_REMOTE values containing URL userinfo, or parse credentials out and supply them only through the per-invocation credential helper while persisting a sanitized tokenless URL. Fail closed if the URL cannot be safely normalized.
findings.acceptance: Run the publisher with a credential-bearing CLAUDE_HUB_REMOTE against a disposable repository and assert it rejects the value or that `git -C "$HUB_DIR" config --get remote.origin.url` contains no password/token/userinfo; also confirm authenticated fetch and push still use only ephemeral credential injection.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read the credential helper at lines 258-269, clone/configuration path at lines 330-360, and target selection at lines 812-825 in the immutable baseline. The safe CLAUDE_HUB_REPO branch constructs a tokenless URL and enables ephemeral token auth, but the higher-priority CLAUDE_HUB_REMOTE branch bypasses that path and line 356 persists its exact value; no validation or sanitization intervenes.
